append.detail: Built 2026-11-16. lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts is the pure projection: a published version names one host Event (hunt_versions.policy.finale.event_id), and the finale is open only when the run is complete AND the Events tables show the player holds a seat at that Event (a succeeded, unrefunded event_tickets row, or a going event_rsvps row the host is not still deciding). A full Event, no ticket or RSVP, a waitlist place, a pending request, a seat at any other Event and a refunded ticket each refuse, as does a cancelled, removed or unpublished Event or one hosted by a Space that is neither the Hunt's own nor a live partner (FH-029). lib/hunts/rally-finale-store.ts reads the facts scoped to the host Event and the signed-in player, takes the seat count from lib/events/capacity.ts, and contains no write or function call, so the Hunt cannot admit anyone. Door evidence (assurance event_door) exists only for a seat the host marked present at that Event; a self check-in is shown but is not door evidence. grantFinaleReward refuses a completion award without that access before the database is called. Tests: lib/hunts/rally-finale.test.ts and rally-finale-store.test.ts cover full Event, absent ticket, wrong Event and refunded ticket. No migration, no new switch. Not yet wired to a screen or a route: that is FH-031S. FH-030 (a listed requirement) was not needed for this read model.
